singleSourced.context: Just like with Hot Wheels Unleashed 1 and 2, this one's being made by the racing specialists over at Milestone, and the focus this time is to "race beyond the orange track and jump into a Hot Wheels-sized world with four islands to explore".
The base price is £44.99 / $49.99, although there's also a Deluxe version along with an Ultimate Edition - the latter of which allows you to begin playing today in early access for £89.99 / $99.99.

Collecting all the cars and blasting through races is very enjoyable, and controlling these die-cast toys retains its appeal despite the game's faults."

And here's what other sites had to say about this new open-world take on the series:

Vooks - 3.5/5: "Hot Wheels Infinite Rush is a fast-paced arcade-style racer that makes the most of the Hot Wheels brand.

There are plenty of hours of racing, challenges and collectibles to keep you busy, if you don’t mind some minor issues here and there that may become frustrating over time."

COGConnected - 65/100: "Ultimately, Hot Wheels Infinite Rush delivers a basic but enjoyable experience.

Still, it manages to justify itself by being a fun and welcoming title that sits comfortably behind the wheel."

Hardcore Gamer - 4.5/5: "Hot Wheels Infinite Rush is a fantastic experience that manages to draw the magic of Hot Wheels in an open world video game.
